Senior PM — Performance & Reviews, London hybrid.

Talently is an HR-tech platform for performance reviews and career-development planning, used by 400+ mid-market companies; we closed our Series C last quarter and revenue is growing more than 3x year-on-year. We're hiring a Senior PM to own the performance-review module — calibration workflows, manager dashboards, and goal-cascading features. You'll work independently with a pod of two engineers and one designer, with no direct reports. Hybrid: two days a week in our London office. We're looking for someone who has shipped B2B SaaS workflow tools for HR or People teams — deep familiarity with HR processes like calibration cycles and 9-box grids is what makes someone successful here.
